tagline: Leading owner of clean energy generation assets across North America
hero_kpi_rationale: As one of the largest owners of clean energy generation assets in the United States with a diversified portfolio of solar, wind, and battery storage, CWEN leverages the global energy transition and growing demand for decarbonized electricity.

kpis.name: Solar energy generated and sold
kpis.explanation: Amount of solar energy generated and sold by CWEN in thousands of MWh
kpis.description: CWEN is one of the largest solar energy producers in the United States with a growing portfolio driven by strategic acquisitions
kpis.signal: Growth in solar capacity and energy production

kpis.name: Wind energy generated and sold
kpis.explanation: Amount of wind energy generated and sold by CWEN in thousands of MWh
kpis.description: CWEN is one of the largest wind energy producers in the United States with approximately 10.1 GW of wind capacity in its portfolio
kpis.signal: Growth in wind capacity and energy production

kpis.name: Battery storage energy generated and sold
kpis.explanation: Amount of battery storage energy generated and sold by CWEN in thousands of MWh
kpis.description: CWEN is one of the largest owners of battery energy storage systems (BESS) in the United States, a rapidly growing segment with multiple acquisitions and developments in 2025
kpis.signal: Growth in energy storage capacity and grid flexibility solutions

kpis.name: Total operating revenues
kpis.explanation: Total operating revenues of CWEN including energy and capacity, other revenues, less contract amortization and hedging adjustments
kpis.description: CWEN generates its revenues primarily through long-term power purchase agreements (PPA) with investment-grade counterparties
kpis.signal: Revenue growth driven by acquisitions and increased energy production

kpis.name: Operating income
kpis.explanation: Operating income (EBIT) of CWEN before financial charges and taxes
kpis.description: The decline in operating income reflects higher operating and depreciation expenses due to acquisitions and integration of new assets
kpis.signal: Decline in operating profitability due to rising operating and depreciation costs

risks.title: High debt levels and significant interest expenses
risks.score_rationale: The company bears significant interest expenses ($356M in 2025) and has limited financing capacity, despite ongoing strategic acquisitions.

risks.title: Exposure to market and weather condition fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to seasonal variations, weather conditions, and energy price fluctuations that affect production and revenues.

risks.title: Regulatory and policy risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a complex regulatory environment and is exposed to changes in energy policy and modifications to renewable energy support mechanisms.

risks.title: Asset and operational performance risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to asset deterioration, equipment failures, and operational risks related to the maintenance of its facilities.

risks.title: Management and integration risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is undertaking numerous acquisitions and development projects (repowering) that require effective management and integration.

risks.title: Reputation and social acceptability risks
risks.score_rationale: As a renewable energy producer, the company may face local opposition or social acceptability challenges related to its projects.
